name: lean4-formal-verifier
description: Strict Lean module checks, project-declaration axiom audits, reviewed registry integration, and English card drafts
runtime: Python 3.10+ on POSIX, elan/Lake with the project's pinned Lean toolchain
manifest_format: project-local descriptive manifest; not a standard MCP client configuration
trust: trusted repository and toolchain; Lean and Lake may execute local code

mutations.scaffold: temporary Lean candidate and build artifacts, cleaned on normal completion
mutations.integrate: dry-run by default; --apply edits registry and root, rolls back sources on failure
mutations.card: returns draft on stdout; does not write knowledge files
mutations.audit: Strict rebuild and audit; Lake build artifacts
